tools.name: about_nwb
tools.description: Approved facts about the miracle berry, its three taste effects, the company and its certifications. Read-only.

tools.name: how_to_use
tools.description: The approved four steps, the serving and how long the effect lasts. Read-only.

tools.name: ask_nwb
tools.description: Looks up an approved answer by topic and returns it word for word. With no approved answer it returns "No approved answer yet. Email info@natureswildberry.com." Read-only.

tools.name: where_to_buy
tools.description: Consumer marketplaces that sell Nature's Wild Berry, each with its link, plus our own store, whether we are in physical stores, how orders are placed and where prices are shown. Read-only.

tools.name: wholesale_and_foodservice
tools.description: How stores can order the Travel Case. No wholesale prices. Read-only.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Live product names, prices, crossed-out prices as the store shows them, each variant_id, whether a Subscribe and Save plan is available, a product link and a Shopify checkout link, plus customer reviews that passed review screening. Read-only.

tools.name: recommend_product
tools.description: Matches a first purchase, a group or a refill to a live product. Returns the current price and a one-time cart link or the website subscription path. In-chat checkout depends on the shopping platform. Read-only.

tools.name: build_cart
tools.description: Returns one natureswildberry.com link that fills the shopper's cart with the chosen variants, one-time or Subscribe and Save, a line-by-line summary and the store's Shopify agent checkout endpoint (which does not support subscriptions). Nothing is bought until the shopper checks out. Read-only.

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Approved shipping and guarantee summaries with links to the store's policy pages. Read-only.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_nwb, get_products, recommend_product · Public sink: ask_nwb.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_nwb, get_products, recommend_product · Public sink: ask_nwb

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "where_to_buy" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Consumer marketplaces that sell Nature's Wild Berry, each with its link, plus our own store. Read-only." → after: "Consumer marketplaces that sell Nature's Wild Berry, each with its link, plus our own store, whether we are in physical stores, how orders are placed and where prices are shown. Read-only."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
